adjudication.rationale: The diff makes `destinationCalendar` an array and `EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents` now loops over each destination, calling `createEvent(credential, event, destination.externalId)` (packages/core/EventManager.ts). However `CalendarManager.createEvent` ignores that `externalId` for selecting the target calendar and always calls `calendar.createEvent(calEvent, credential.id)` (packages/core/CalendarManager.ts). Google’s implementation uses that `credentialId` to pick the matching destination calendar (`find(cal.credentialId === credentialId)`), but non-Google services still derive `calendarId` from the first destination only via `const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = event.destinationCalendar ?? []; const calendarId = mainHostDestinationCalendar?.externalId;` (office365/larkcalendar and BaseCalendarService CalDAV). So when creating events for multiple hosts on the same non-Google integration, host B’s event creation will still target host A’s externalId, leading to incorrect/missing event creation for other hosts.
